issues.legal_issue: The bar under Order II Rule 2 CPC applies only when the subsequent suit is founded on the same cause of action as the earlier suit and seeks a claim or relief the plaintiff was entitled to pursue in the earlier suit.
The pendency or disposal of the earlier suit does not determine whether the bar under Order II Rule 2 CPC applies.

For an application to reject a plaint under Order VII Rule 11(d) CPC based on Order II Rule 2, the plaints must be read as a whole to determine whether their causes of action are identical in substance.
A subsequent suit is not barred under Order II Rule 2 CPC where the relief sought was impossible to obtain when the earlier suit was filed and became available only after a later event.

The subsequent suit for specific performance and cancellation of the later sale deed was not barred by Order II Rule 2 CPC because the reliefs became available after the ban on registration of sale deeds was lifted.
